correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, use the known row norms in the square-root conductance normalization. At fixed t, g_0 decreases in n while a(g_0−g_m)=(1−x)(1−y)/(1−xy) with x=r^floor(n/2), y=r^ceil(n/2) increases: one exponent increments and each partial derivative in x,y is strictly negative. This also bounds the latter expression by one, so every spoke row is strictly below two. The rim row strictly increases in n. At five rims multiply R_5<2 by positive quantities and substitute sqrt(t)=(1−u²)/u, u=sqrt(r). The resulting (1−u^4)p(u) is positive: p>=15/64 for u<=1/2 and the cleared polynomial in v=(2u−1)/(1−u) has all coefficients positive on the other half. With n=6,t=1/4 the exact periodic Green recurrence gives g_0=1188/1105 and g_3=512/1105 and rim row 2292/1105>2. Thus this same weight works for every n>=6 and no weight works at sizes 3–5. The repair's exact standard-library verifier ran successfully, checking both coefficient identities and the full rational Green column and witness. The frozen script was inspected, not executed.

evidence: 3efd9f463ccd has unit spokes and common rim weight q. Dividing all conductances of the frozen wheel by t gives q=1/t and multiplies its grounded Green matrix by t, leaving the projector unchanged. The formulas and crossover agree, including the reciprocal expansion. 169e544dd2d8 gives the same norm in the same normalization, also for the complementary projection. c1aaa10e9030 gives the same norm and crossover. d57fbcbd9da9 minimizes the projection norm over all projections onto an unweighted circulation space, with level 9/5 at six rims.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The energy-normalized gradient and orthogonal cut projector are the same. Symmetry identifies its 1-to-1 and infinity-to-infinity norms, and the published identity covers the orthogonal complement too. In contrast, minimizing over projections changes the invariant and the meaning of six. None of the inspected same-projector Finding passages gives the sharpened finite-size boundary at level two.

residual_risks: Bounded public literature search was nondiagnostic; an unindexed statement in electrical-network or projection language remains possible. No conclusion about historical priority follows from matching catalogue paths or snapshot dates.

value.rationale: The coordinatewise norm is the worst possible amplification of normalized measurement error. Locating the first wheel size where it can exceed a factor of two separates an all-weights guarantee at small sizes from an explicit construction that works at every larger size. The global sign certificate is essential to ruling out smaller counterexamples; the exact rational witness and already known formula, by themselves, would not establish the cutoff.
